approvers: Wife/family, my tax adviser and the broker running the sale; the buyer's bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. I have 7 people who depend on me, and I won't waste months on a buyer who may not have the money.
objection: Belize company, no money committed, 30% paid over three years by a firm nobody knows. If it falls over, I have lost a year and my staff are worried.
instead: Let my adviser run the sale through nexxt-change and take the highest cash offer from a buyer with proven funds, or hand over to a trade competitor or employee.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds in a German bank, an EU-registered buyer with references from earlier deals, and at least 90% cash at closing at a higher multiple.
